outperformance.speedup_on_piecewise_II.reason: No speedup tier is met: CER never reaches the better baseline's maximum-budget mean of 6.43768. outperformance.speedup_on_non_differenti.reason: CER is worse at every budget, but exceeds the larger per-method standard deviation at exactly one budget. Matches and slight_regression require no beyond-one-standard-deviation regression, while clear_regression requires at least two such budgets. No allowed tier covers this observed case.

justification.quality_on_diffusion_3d.reason: The saved diffusion comparison meets the substantial-speedup conditions, making the conditional non-speedup justification requirement inapplicable.
